newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea Fin Min official sees OECD ratification.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea Fin Min official sees OECD ratification.

text.p: A senior South Korean finance ministry official said on Wednesday he expected parliament to ratify the nation's entry into the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD).

"We should get it passed by the end of the current session," said Cho Yoon-je, senior counsellor to the Finance Minister. The current session of the National Assembly is scheduled to end on December 18.
Cho said opposition parties who have threatened to block South Korea's entry into the OECD by opposing ratification in parliament "did not have a concrete case".
He said he expected those parties to use South Korea's entry into the OECD as a "political bargaining chip" and that the government was well prepared to answer their concerns on the issue.
The Paris-based OECD formally invited South Korea to join the club of industrialised nations on October 11. South Korea had submitted its application in March 1995.
